text:
Which branch is it?

Posts about this keep coming up every few days with tons of misinformation spread. 
The demand to register the marriage abroad was cancelled back in 2024. PIBA is not authorized to require this anymore, not at the end and not at the beginning of the process. According to the protocol, when a person didnt register their marriage in their home country, they should provide a new, recent personal status certificate from their home country to finish the process (this is to prove they didn't marry someone else back home and that they are still single etc).

We suspect there was some wrong briefing at PIBA recently about this because the demand keeps coming up over and over even though it is illegal. I can tell you this is currently in legal review in a couple of other cases that are represented by lawyers.
